Guideline: Use state management for complex apps
Description: Shared app state needs an explicit owner such as a ChangeNotifier view model; Flutter leaves the state-management package to the team
Do: Keep shared state in view models or a state-management package the team can test
Don't: setState for state shared across screens
Code Bad: A global variable mutated from several widgets

Guideline: Inject dependencies instead of using globals
Description: Flutter's architecture recommendations strongly recommend dependency injection and suggest the provider package for it
Do: Provide repositories and view models through provider or an equivalent injection approach
Use the spacing parameter of Row/Column or a SizedBox gap

Code Good: Extract widget to method or class

Don't: ListView with children for large lists

Guideline: Use a routing package for deep links
Description: Apps with deep links, web URLs, or several navigators need declarative routing
Do: go_router (or the Router API) for deep links and web URLs
Don't: Imperative Navigator.push as the only routing for an app with deep links
Code Bad: Navigator.push everywhere in a web app with shareable URLs

Guideline: Avoid named routes for most apps
Description: Flutter's navigation docs do not recommend named routes for most apps: deep-link handling cannot be customized and the browser forward button is not supported
Do: Use go_router or Navigator with MaterialPageRoute
Don't: MaterialApp.routes with pushNamed in apps that need deep links or web navigation

Description: Android back and predictive back require declaring ahead of time whether a route may pop; WillPopScope and PopScope.onPopInvoked are deprecated
Don't: WillPopScope or PopScope.onPopInvoked in new code
Code Good: PopScope(canPop: false, onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) { if (!didPop) confirmExit(); })

Guideline: Create the Future outside build for FutureBuilder
Description: FutureBuilder's future must be obtained earlier (initState, didUpdateWidget, or didChangeDependencies); creating it during build restarts the work on every rebuild
Do: Store the Future in State and pass the stored instance
Don't: Call the fetch function inside build
Code Good: late final Future<Data> _data = fetchData(); ... FutureBuilder(future: _data, builder: ...)

Do: Read colors and text styles from the theme's colorScheme and textTheme

Description: Material 3 is the default since Flutter 3.16; components read color roles from ColorScheme
Do: Build the theme from a ColorScheme
Don't: Configure individual legacy color properties such as primaryColor

Code Good: MaterialApp(theme: lightTheme, darkTheme: darkTheme) with both built from ColorScheme.fromSeed(..., brightness: ...)

Description: Text scales with the user's setting through TextScaler; textScaleFactor is deprecated since Flutter 3.16 and Android 14 scales text nonlinearly
Do: Let text scale; use MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context) when sizing around text and clamp only where layout requires it
Don't: Read textScaleFactor or force a fixed scale on body text

Description: dart:io Platform is unavailable on web; adapt UI with defaultTargetPlatform or Theme.of(context).platform
Do: defaultTargetPlatform or Theme.of(context).platform for adaptive UI
Don't: dart:io Platform checks in code that also runs on web
Code Bad: if (Platform.isIOS) {} in code compiled for web

Description: Review a package before depending on it
Do: Check likes, pub points, downloads, publisher, recent releases, SDK constraints, and license
Don't: Add a package by name alone
Code Good: Recent release, passing pub points checks, compatible SDK constraints
